operator_assessment.operator_summary: Deterministic hard verification passes and export formats are internally consistent (csv/ical/excel row counts all match the plan). This export reflects a targeted maintenance pass that resolved the Jar U10 and Frisk Asker U10 home_representation sibling-skew findings via revision-bound, consequence-acceptable sibling swaps, with no change to any date/time/arena/host. The plan is usable for continued club review, but is not yet clean enough for public publication: it still carries substantial pre-existing, unrelated open items (participation shortfalls, hosting-balance imbalances, an external-calendar conflict, a host-confirmation dependency, and unplaced-tournament obligations) that predate and are unaffected by this pass.

key_tradeoffs.title: Home-representation repairs traded opponent repetition for balance
key_tradeoffs.summary: The Jar U10 and Frisk Asker U10 sibling swaps applied to fix skewed home representation increased opponent-repeat counts by 1-3 for several retained teams and added one new 7-13/14-day gap; both are accepted soft trade-offs under the home_representation repair policy, which deliberately treats opponent identity/gap changes as non-blocking evidence rather than a hard rule, since swapping which sibling represents a club necessarily changes opponents.

key_tradeoffs.title: Two home_representation findings left unresolved by design
key_tradeoffs.summary: Frisk Asker U9 and Frisk Asker JU12 have no consequence-acceptable repair in the current bounded search: every candidate is blocked by a genuine <7-day gap, a materially worse travel figure, or (for JU12) would turn an even 9/9 sibling participation split into an uneven 8/10. These were deliberately left as open findings rather than forced through.

remaining_actions.title: 111 participation shortfalls / 24 target deviations remain open
remaining_actions.summary: Pre-existing club-pool participation shortfalls and target deviations are unresolved season-wide; unaffected by this pass.

remaining_actions.title: 14 hosting-balance imbalances remain open
remaining_actions.summary: Pre-existing hosting-balance imbalances are unresolved season-wide; unaffected by this pass.

remaining_actions.title: 2 external-calendar conflicts and 1 host-confirmation dependency remain open
remaining_actions.summary: rvv-0033/rvv-0057 remain on fixed_busy/external-conflict placements and rvv-0053 still needs Kongsberg's confirmation for a movable_busy allocation; unaffected by this pass.

remaining_actions.title: 12 unplaced-tournament obligations remain open
remaining_actions.summary: 12 tournament-placement shortfalls are unresolved season-wide; unaffected by this pass.

remaining_actions.title: 2 residual home_representation findings
remaining_actions.summary: Frisk Asker U9 and Frisk Asker JU12 sibling home representation remain skewed with no currently acceptable repair; re-check after any future roster/date change that might open a legal swap.

limitations: This audit re-verifies the checklist and evidence surfaced by the repository's own audit-context/plan_audit_summary; it does not independently re-derive participation targets, hosting quotas or calendar trustworthiness from source data.

The pre-existing REVIEW_REQUIRED-worthy items (participation, hosting, calendar, placement) were not investigated further because they are outside the scope of the requested home_representation maintenance pass.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Not independently re-derived in this pass; export_consistency_summary shows team-count/participation projections match the plan (142 teams with season targets, no export mismatches). Not part of the requested home_representation maintenance.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: This pass specifically targeted sibling home-tournament-count skew. Jar U10 and Frisk Asker U10 are now balanced (material_spread 0). Frisk Asker U9 (spread 1) and Frisk Asker JU12 (spread 1) remain skewed with no consequence-acceptable repair currently available.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: duration_summary reports 100-155 minutes across all tournaments with zero missing-duration entries; unaffected by this pass and shows no anomaly.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: One host-controlled movable_busy allocation (rvv-0053, Kongsberg U12) still requires host confirmation, and two tournaments (rvv-0033, rvv-0057) sit on fixed_busy/external-calendar placements. Both are pre-existing and unrelated to the home_representation swaps applied.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar vertsklubben i samme turnering?
checklist_findings.finding: host_participation_summary reports 0 tournaments where the host club is not among the participants.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic hard verification (verify_candidate) reports ok=true with zero violations, which includes the one-game-per-day rule; the applied sibling swaps re-ran full hard verification and stayed ok.

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: same_club_per_tournament_summary shows 105 tournaments with exactly 2 same-club teams and 10 with 3 (visible exception), consistent with policy; none of the tournaments touched by this pass introduced a new 3-team case.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: export_consistency_summary reports matches_plan true for csv_games, csv_overview, csv_team_counts, ical and excel, with zero mismatches, for the freshly regenerated export.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: No new planner rule or export bug found. The season still carries substantial pre-existing open items unrelated to this pass: 111 participation shortfalls, 24 participation-target deviations, 14 hosting-balance imbalances, 2 external-calendar conflicts, 1 host-confirmation dependency and 12 unplaced-tournament obligations (see publication_readiness). These are real, currently-open operational gaps, not artifacts of the home_representation repairs, and are why publication_readiness independently reports REVIEW_REQUIRED/not publishable.
